contact_2_reports.summary: Spacecraft healthy and within plan envelope at AOS+6s. EPS NOMINAL, SUNLIT with symmetric array currents ~1.7A each, battery SOC ~100% and voltage 8.20V GREEN, load 1.40A <1.5A envelope, bus 5.0V nominal. Payload ON at 1.0 Hz after successful re-activation at 12603. Command counters ACC 2/REJ 0, no rejects, frame counter advancing, staleness GREEN, link CONNECTED.

Spacecraft healthy and nominal in contact. All envelope limits satisfied: SOC 99.99% >35%, BATT_V 8.20V >7.2V, LOAD_I 1.40A <1.5A, MODE NOMINAL. Energy positive (BATT_I +0.0005A SUNLIT) with symmetric SA currents 1.7A. Payload ON at 1.0 Hz for SAA coverage per PROC-001 health assessment.
